title: Swarm: 9-probe health (Consul + Nomad + Portainer + Docker Swarm)
description: Runs `nexus health swarm`. Nine probes: Consul members + leader, Nomad servers + leader + clients, Portainer reachability, and Docker Swarm managers + workers + raft leader.

observe.what: overall=green; consul 6 alive/0 failed + leader; nomad 3 servers/1 leader/3 ready; portainer reachable (v2.39.3); swarm 3/3 + 3/3 Ready + 1 leader

whatProves: SwarmAdapter.HealthAsync rolls the three control planes (Consul/Nomad/Portainer via the reused clients) together with the authoritative docker node ls quorum view into one health report.
